bestBets.overview: Plenty of debutants from strong stables so watch market closely. Have liked the jumpout form of VELVET MORNING. Drawn bit awkwardly on debut but happy to have something each way if any stable support. RED MINK is another that has been winning her jumpout/trial and she has drawn to get all the favours and must consider. KUNG FU PANDA was not beaten all that far on synthetic on debut then bit flat last start. Third-up and must include while MEET THE PRINCE was in the market at first start and showed good pace. Had break since and will take catching fresh.

raceTips.comment: A few interesting debutants here and it might end up being a reasonable maiden if they all start. Leaning to a value play early in Bordeaux from the McEvoy yard at $12, who returns after two plain runs with excuses last prep. The jumpout form is solid as is the draw to get a soft run here and the chance to find raceday form. Velvet Morning and Red Mink have both won their only two jumpouts and both look handy without being tested so far ahead of their debuts. Perhaps the former looked a little more professional in them but both can win here. Prestige Hellbent is another on debut who has jumped out nicely and Matt Laurie coming to Tatura is worth noting. The wider draw will add to the test though.

bestBets.overview: ZIGGY BAMA stayed tough and was able to share the prize at Ballarat synthetic on debut. Sure to be better from the race experience and expect he will win better races than this. DIVINE EMPRESS is fresh from a spell. She is yet to be placed first-up but two recent strong jumpout wins suggest she may just be ready for this. PACIFIC GLAMOUR led them up for a long way at Bendigo last start. If she finds the front she will be competitive again while CUMBOOGLE gets back in his right class and he can bounce back.

raceTips.comment: Cumboogle has a big weight but if she can find a position from a sticky gate, could take some catching down in class off recent racing. Ziggy Bama was green last start when winning in a dead heat on debut and rises in class here but jumpouts suggest he's got ability and can only improve the manners. Being tested away from the synthetic is another question to answer for him. Pacific Glamour has been OK for the new yard for the drop in class here and finds a bit of a day in the sun from a good gate, but best stacks up. Divine Empress has looked slick at the jumpouts and can race well here though 1000m looks short of her previous best.
